subject: AWS Marketplace: webhook idempotency & invoice mapping for pilot
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@clearwave.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearwave.com
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace integration: invoice sample + webhook retries

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to send a concrete example of how our billing will flow through AWS Marketplace so your team can validate mapping to Redwood SKUs and confirm webhook retry/idempotency behavior.

Attached: invoice_sample.csv — this is a sanitized subset of our expected monthly billing export (consumption quantity, sku_id, buyer_org, usage_date, invoice_id). Two asks:
- Can Redwood map invoice rows to your "sku" and "entitlement" model for the fulfillment file? We need deterministic mapping so our accounting ties back to ClearWave POs.
- How do you guarantee webhook idempotency for metering/fulfillment events (retry semantics from AWS and your retry handling)? We want to avoid duplicate entitlements/invoice lines.

If helpful, happy to block a 30-min call later this week — procurement + engineering will join.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Sr. Finance Manager
ClearWave Analytics
[attachment: invoice_sample.csv (CSV, 6KB)]

Elena — thanks for the sample, this is perfect. Looping in Kimberly (fulfillment lead) and Ben (billing instrumentation) to confirm on mapping and retry patterns.

Quick plan:
1) Redwood will produce an expected webhook schema and recommended idempotency key (we typically use a composite: invoice_id + sku_id + usage_date). See attached webhook_schema.yaml.
2) Kimberly will validate required ledger fields and produce a mapping table back to your invoice columns.
3) We'll run a short pilot for one invoice cycle (non-production) and exchange results before go-live.

Proposed times: Thu 10/8 11:00 AM PT or Fri 10/9 2:00 PM PT — which works for procurement + eng?

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace integration: invoice sample + webhook retries

Thanks for looping me in — reviewed Elena's invoice_sample.csv. A few notes and asks from the fulfillment side:

- Field mapping: we can map invoice_sample.csv columns to Redwood's fulfillment rows: sku_id -> product_sku, quantity -> consumption_units, invoice_id -> external_invoice_ref, usage_date -> event_date. I'll produce a one-tab mapping in fulfillment_mapping.xlsx.
- Idempotency key: agreed on invoice_id + sku_id + usage_date as the primary key. However, if ClearWave aggregates by buyer_org per invoice, we should include buyer_org to avoid cross-tenant collisions.
- Retry handling: AWS may re-deliver Marketplace notifications; our ingestion pipeline first checks for an existing fulfillment row by idempotency key and either upserts or skips based on reconciliation window (default 72 hours). We can tighten to 24 hours for pilot.
- Edge case: prorations or negative adjustments — please flag those rows in a column adjustment_type so we can surface them to accounting.

Attaching a draft mapping file (fulfillment_mapping.xlsx) and a short SOW paragraph we usually include for metering/fulfillment handoffs.

On the call we should: confirm exact CSV headers, agree on idempotency key, and sign-off on reconciliation window.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Fulfillment & Integrations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: fulfillment_mapping.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)]
